hierarchy.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight leading-tight

navigation_structure.desktop_behavior: Always visible sidebar with genuine toggle expand/collapse (expanded 256px, collapsed 72px)

header_bar.style: backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#090A0F]/80 border-b border-white/10 sticky top-0 z-40 px-6 py-4 flex justify-between items-center

step_1_product_input.title: Product Context & References
components: Multi-Image Uploader component for reference images (`data-testid='input-product-images'`)
Creative Instruction / Prompt Master (`data-testid='input-creative-instruction'`) - internal only indicator

step_2_creative_preset.title: Category & Capability Configuration
components: Content Category Selector: UGC, Unboxing, Reviewer (`data-testid='select-content-type'`)
Target Duration selector (e.g. 10s: 3s intro, 4s demo, 3s CTA)
Resolved Video Engine capability pill (Live Adapter `acs-video-adapter-v1` vs Honest Fallback)

step_3_storyboard_review.title: Derived Creative Direction & Scene Storyboard
components: Derived Objective, Audience Angle, and Hook Cards
3-Scene Intent Timeline Matrix (`data-testid='storyboard-scenes'`) displaying visual prompt, motion action, and duration per scene

step_4_generation_execution.title: Real AI Video Execution & Validation Gate
components: Execution Status Banner: Live Adapter payload processing or Explicit Fallback notification
Validation provenance metadata: requestId, provider, providerJobId, artifact validation status (`passed` / `fallback`)
Honest transparency banner: Never fabricates fake job IDs or video outputs

step_5_affiliate_package.title: Canonical Affiliate Package Output
features: Playable Video Container with HTML5 video player

archive_and_restoration.title: Project Archive & History
archive_and_restoration.behavior: Restores exact stored state without triggering re-generation when navigating back, refreshing page, or re-logging.
archive_and_restoration.list_view: Grid of saved projects showing project name, product image thumbnail, content type, generation mode (live/fallback), creation date, and restore button (`data-testid='btn-restore-project-{id}'`).

testing_contract.mandatory_data_testid_rules: All buttons, form inputs, navigation links, tabs, video elements, and status badges MUST have explicit data-testid attributes in kebab-case.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Preserve ACS Core architecture and node backend contracts without breaking existing APIs
Ensure dark theme aesthetic is cohesive, using deep charcoal/obsidian surfaces (#090A0F) with glowing neon violet (#8B5CF6) and cyan accents (#06B6D4)
Never hide navigation links behind drop-downs on desktop; maintain a persistent collapsible sidebar
Always display honest capability resolution: if video generator API is unreachable or not configured, show clear fallback badge without fake video generation
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes for E2E testing
Do not include unrelated billing, payments, subscription tiers, or admin marketplace screens
instructions_to_main_agent: Use this design system specification to render the full-stack ACS V3 React application with full fidelity to the blueprint.
